# Guru Bhajan Singh

> MERN Stack Developer (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) with 7+ years of full-stack web development experience. Also skilled in PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter and WordPress.

## Summary
Guru Bhajan Singh is a Sr. Web Developer based in Noida, India, currently working at CloudThat Technologies Pvt. Ltd. He specializes in the MERN stack and recently built an AI Receptionist application end-to-end (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). He has 7+ years of experience, 200+ completed projects, and has previously worked at Cross Section Interactive, MateBiz, Gartndev Web Studios, and Benzaitens Group.

## Core Skills
- MERN Stack: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js
- PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter, WordPress (theme/plugin development)
- JavaScript, Vue.js, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap
- MySQL, MongoDB
- AWS, Git, REST API development
- Third-party integrations: Google Login/Geolocation/reCAPTCHA, Facebook Login, Push Notifications, Vonage video calls

## Featured Project
- AI Receptionist — a conversational AI receptionist web app built end-to-end on the MERN stack, automating visitor/caller interactions, appointment queries and information routing.
